inherits.scope: The HD6303R uses the documented HD6801-compatible timer, GPIO, register, and RAM-control functions on the same die as the HD6301V1, with mask ROM disabled; its SCI framing-error rule is specified here because it differs from MC6801.
restrictions: The RTL profile implements every available HD6303R operating mode: non-multiplexed Mode 1 and multiplexed Modes 2 and 4.
Modes 0, 5, 6, and 7 are unavailable on the HD6303R because its mask ROM is disabled.
Physical Port 3 address/data multiplexing, address strobe, and electrical timing are not claimed by the normalized external-memory interface.
Oscillator recovery and analog RAM-retention thresholds remain outside this digital profile.

timer.counter: 16-bit wrapping up-counter clocked once per E-cycle and reset to 0000; an FRC_MSB write presets FFF8 while saving the bus byte, and a following FRC_LSB write replaces the full counter with the saved high byte and current low byte
timer.coherent_read: reading high latches low; low reads return that latch
timer.output_compare: match sets OCF and transfers OLVL to P21; comparison is inhibited for the upper-byte write cycle and the following cycle
timer.input_capture: selected P20 edge transfers the synchronized counter and sets ICF; P20 must be configured as input
timer.overflow: TOF is set when the counter increments from FFFF to 0000

flag_clear.ICF: read TCSR while set, then read ICR_MSB
flag_clear.OCF: read TCSR while set, then write either OCR byte
flag_clear.TOF: read TCSR while set, then read FRC_MSB

timer.interrupt: enabled ICF, OCF, and TOF generate IRQ2 and select distinct priority vectors

sci.compatibility: The asynchronous transmitter, receiver, clocks, controls, flags, and interrupt functions follow the documented HD6801-compatible SCI except for the explicitly listed framing-error transfer rule.
sci.framing_error: A missing stop bit sets ORFE without RDRF and does not transfer the receive shift-register byte into RDR.
sci.implemented_clock_modes: internally clocked NRZ with divisors 16, 128, 1024, and 4096, plus external NRZ divided from eight sampled P22 positive edges per bit
sci.reserved_clock_modes: CC1:CC0=00 has no format or clock source; the wrapper disables the Motorola-only bi-phase engine

reference.locator: HD6301V1 table 2-6-2 and sections 2.6(5)-(7), printed pages 153-154; HD6303R common-die statement, printed page 126

operating_modes.mode2: expanded multiplexed ROMless operation with internal registers and RAME-controlled 128-byte RAM; implemented
operating_modes.mode1: expanded non-multiplexed ROMless operation with Port 1 as A0-A7, Port 3 as D0-D7, and Port 4 as A8-A15; implemented at the normalized bus boundary
operating_modes.mode4: expanded multiplexed RAM operation documented as equivalent to Mode 2; implemented without Motorola Mode-4 RAM mirroring or Mode-5 transition leakage
operating_modes.unavailable: Modes 0, 5, 6, and 7 are not available on HD6303R because its mask ROM is disabled
operating_modes.sleep: SLP stops CPU execution while peripherals continue; an enabled interrupt vectors, while a masked interrupt request resumes at the following instruction
operating_modes.standby: standby_n_i is sampled at the normalized E boundary; accepted STBY resets active state, suppresses the external bus and GPIO drive, retains RAM/STBY_PWR with valid supply, and restarts through the external reset vector

reference.locator: HD6301V1/HD6303R notice; sections 2.1, 2.2, and 2.12, tables 2-1-1 and 2-2-1, printed pages 126-139 and 162-166

implementation_scope.rtl: rtl/hd6301/hd6303r_mcu.sv binds the HD6301 CPU profile to every legal HD6303R Mode-1/2/4 peripheral, RAM, and external-memory configuration
implementation_scope.verification: Directed execution repeats external reset vectoring, internal RAM, AIM, XGDX, SLP peripheral continuity, masked-request wake, opcode TRAP, E-synchronous STBY, external-bus suppression, reset-vector recovery, and retained RAM/STBY_PWR in Modes 1, 2, and 4; a separate decode suite checks all mode-specific register, ROMless, RAM, and Port-1 facts
implementation_scope.address_error: All legal modes span external memory around the internal register/RAM windows, so the address-error table defines no non-memory fetch region; opcode error still invokes TRAP
implementation_scope.excluded_modes: Port 3 physical data/address multiplexing, AS/RW half-cycle waveforms, and oscillator recovery delay remain unclaimed
